description: Flat metadata schema for individual soil samples sequenced for fungal ITS amplicons in agricultural systems, including farming practice, soil properties, and sequencing assay context.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual soil sample or sequencing record.

study_site_id.descr: Identifier for the field/site or farm where the sample was collected.

plot_id.descr: Identifier for the experimental plot or management unit within the site.

replicate_id.descr: Replicate number or label for the sample within the plot/treatment.

collection_date.descr: Date the soil sample was collected (YYYY-MM-DD).

country.descr: Country where the sample was collected.

region.descr: State, province, or administrative region of the sampling location.

elevation_m.descr: Sampling elevation in meters above sea level.

farm_management_system.descr: Primary farming system or management category; examples include conventional, no-till, and organic.

tillage_practice.descr: Tillage regime applied at the sampling site; examples include conventional tillage, reduced tillage, and no-till.

crop_type.descr: Dominant crop present at the time of sampling, if applicable.

previous_crop_type.descr: Crop grown in the previous season, if known.

soil_depth_cm.descr: Depth interval of sampled soil in centimeters, expressed as single depth or range as recorded.

soil_texture.descr: Soil texture class, if determined; examples include sandy loam, loam, clay loam.

soil_moisture_percent.descr: Soil moisture content as percent wet weight or gravimetric percent, as reported.

soil_organic_matter_percent.descr: Soil organic matter content as percent.

soil_organic_carbon_gkg.descr: Soil organic carbon concentration in g/kg, if measured.

soil_total_nitrogen_gkg.descr: Total nitrogen concentration in g/kg, if measured.

soil_ph.descr: Soil pH measured in soil suspension or extract.

available_phosphorus_mgkg.descr: Plant-available phosphorus concentration in mg/kg, if measured.

available_potassium_mgkg.descr: Plant-available potassium concentration in mg/kg, if measured.

nitrate_n_mgkg.descr: Nitrate-N concentration in mg/kg, if measured.

ammonium_n_mgkg.descr: Ammonium-N concentration in mg/kg, if measured.

soil_temperature_c.descr: Soil temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius, if measured.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction kit or protocol used for the sample.

its_region_targeted.descr: ITS region amplified; examples include ITS1 or ITS2.

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for ITS amplification.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for ITS amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing platform used; examples include Illumina MiSeq or NovaSeq.

library_prep_protocol.descr: Library preparation protocol or kit used for amplicon sequencing.

read_layout.descr: Read structure used for sequencing; examples include single-end or paired-end.

target_amplicon_length_bp.descr: Expected amplicon length in base pairs.

sequencing_run_id.descr: Identifier for the sequencing run or batch.

raw_read_count.descr: Number of raw reads generated for the sample.

filtered_read_count.descr: Number of reads retained after quality filtering.

fungal_biomass_indicator.descr: Indicator of fungal biomass if measured; specify units in the originating record if using a quantitative assay.

soil_health_indicator.descr: Optional integrated soil health score or index, if computed.

control_sample_flag.descr: True if the record is a control or blank sample rather than a biological soil sample.

sequenced_flag.descr: True if sequencing data were successfully generated for this sample.
